title: I Used the Package-Locker Camera on the Neighbor Who Took My Code

parts.text: My pickup code hit at 4:02 p.m. and at 4:06 the locker was empty. Lobby cam showed neighbor Tad typing my digits from a screenshot over my shoulder. I was thirty-three, tenant, holding the empty bay still. The locker card said: YOUR CODE. YOUR BAY. Tad said it was a mix. Mix is a word screenshots use when a cam exists. I posted the still to the board Tad moderates. Tad returned the box. Codes now time out faster. The lobby finally looks like lockers, not a shoulder. The room sounds like a room again, not a title. Petty is a word people use when their name is on the ticket.

social.video_title: He typed my locker digits from a shoulder shot — Part 1/1
social.description: Empty bay, lobby cam, a returned box. Has a neighbor ever mixed up your code?
